correctness.rationale: The graph has lines of the three equality types, unique rainbow triangles, and precisely n^2/4 intercalates per involution h. Translation stabilizer H_h is the four-element subgroup generated by (h,0),(0,h); all its nontrivial elements are even vertex double-transpositions, hence its oriented tetrahedron orbit contributes Z[T/H_h] to relative C3(X,Z). The pair long exact sequence and cited Cioabă--Mim all-field higher-vanishing theorem yield the asserted integral injection/surjection; coefficient-field independence and UCT rule out the relevant integral torsion. The line-subcomplex plus rainbow triangles has equivariant Euler character minus H0 equal to the tensor of three augmentation characters. No nonidentity translation preserves a rainbow triangle because it has one edge of each adjacency type. Rationally subtract the coset permutation traces n²/4 on H_h and Fourier-decompose using character orthogonality to obtain the formula. Direct independently coded clique-face enumeration against graph adjacency and signed fixed-simplex Lefschetz traces checked all 36 translations for cyclic C6 and all 64 translations for elementary abelian C2^3; they agree with the claimed expression, and the latter has no fixed H2. These finite tests do not establish every abelian group and the inaccessible 2026 primary theorem was not independently read in full.
